title: Libyan PM warns military groups against dragging Libya into Russia-Ukraine war
detail: A news aggregator headline dated Nov 24, 2026 reports that Libya's prime minister warned military groups against dragging the country into the Russia-Ukraine war following the Benghazi incidents. Only the headline was available; the originating outlet, the PM's exact words and the nature of the incidents are unconfirmed.
confidenceReason: Single aggregated headline; originating outlet and details not verified.
